name: get_records
description:
Retrieves a list of DNS records created for a domain name. By default it returns 20 records if no limit is provided. The rest can be retrieved using the pagination options.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v5/domains/{domain}/records --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to list from a request.

since.description: Get records created after this JavaScript timestamp.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

until.description: Get records created before this JavaScript timestamp.
